name: Grid
description: CSS Grid wrapper with token-based gap and responsive columns via container queries. Columns accept a number (1–12), 'auto', or a responsive object { base, sm, md, lg, xl }.

columns.type: number | 'auto' | { base?: number, sm?: number, md?: number, lg?: number, xl?: number }
columns.description: Number of columns (1–12), 'auto' for auto-fill, or responsive object using container queries

gap.description: Spacing token for both row and column gap

rowGap.description: Spacing token for row gap (overrides gap for rows)

colGap.description: Spacing token for column gap (overrides gap for columns)

do: Use responsive columns object for container-query-based responsive layouts
Prefer container queries over viewport breakpoints for component portability
doNot: Do not use Grid for simple vertical or horizontal layouts — use Stack or Inline
Do not use more than 12 columns

accessibility.notes: Grid is a layout utility with no inherent semantics.
